body_md:
Six electricians in or serving Gainesville are listed here with a verified Florida DBPR license: status Current, Active, and type Certified Electrical Contractor. Each record names the license holder, and each listing links to its Florida DBPR license lookup source. Family ownership is stated for Blackwell Electric LLC, Holly Electric, Inc., and Preston-Link Electric, Inc.

## How we picked

License number, type, status, and expiration were taken from a Florida DBPR license lookup, and those facts link to the source page on each listing. All six are Certified Electrical Contractor licenses listed as Current, Active. Named holders are Joseph Bryon Blackwell, Donald Ray Hollingsworth, Wigberto Baez and Wickus Diedericks, Gregory Steven Callahan, Debbie Gera, and George E. Smith, on license numbers EC13004180, EC13005429, EC13004859, EC13003875, EC13007791, and EC0001186. Service area, features, hours, addresses, phone, and website come from those listings. Contacts were checked on November 6, 2026. Years in business are given for Holly Electric, Inc. (more than 20 years) and All Florida Electric Company, Inc. (40+ years).

## At a glance

- DBPR expiration dates are 08/31/2026 for Blackwell Electric LLC, Del Sol Electric, LLC, and Preston-Link Electric, Inc., and 08/31/2028 for Holly Electric, Inc., Callahan Electric LLC, and All Florida Electric Company, Inc. Each status is Current, Active.
- Blackwell Electric LLC lists Newberry, Alachua, Gainesville, and Alachua and Gilchrist counties. Holly Electric, Inc. lists Gainesville and Alachua County, including downtown, the University of Florida area, northwest and southwest Gainesville, Haile Plantation, Jonesville, Tioga, Newberry, Alachua, Hawthorne, and rural Alachua County. Del Sol Electric, LLC lists Gainesville and surrounding areas. All Florida Electric Company, Inc. lists North Central Florida, including the Gainesville community. A service area is not listed for Callahan Electric LLC or Preston-Link Electric, Inc.
- Del Sol Electric, LLC, Preston-Link Electric, Inc., and All Florida Electric Company, Inc. are in Gainesville. Callahan Electric LLC is listed as Gainesville / Alachua. Blackwell Electric LLC is in Newberry and serves Gainesville. Holly Electric, Inc. is in Lake City and serves Gainesville.
- Response notes: Blackwell Electric LLC, Mon-Fri 7:00AM-5:00PM and on call 24/7; Holly Electric, Inc., 24/7 calls; Del Sol Electric, LLC, regular service response within 24 hours and 24-hour emergency service; Preston-Link Electric, Inc., regular service response within 24 hours and 24-hour emergency service when needed.

## Things to know before you go

Match the service-area line to your address before you call. Listed phones are 352-472-6104 for Blackwell Electric LLC, (386) 755-5944 for Holly Electric, Inc., and (352) 451-1094 for Del Sol Electric, LLC. Websites are listed for those three, Preston-Link Electric, Inc., and All Florida Electric Company, Inc.

Holly Electric, Inc. lists an office at 1981 SW Main Blvd, Lake City, FL 32025. Gainesville addresses on the listings are 4000 SW 35th Ter, Gainesville, FL 32608 for Preston-Link Electric, Inc.; 2606 NE 17th Terrace, Gainesville, FL 32609 for All Florida Electric Company, Inc.; and P.O. Box 358581, Gainesville, FL 32635 for Callahan Electric LLC.

Match the features line to the job: residential, commercial, or industrial scope, generators, panel upgrades, free estimates, warranties, Spanish, and permit or inspection coordination where the listing states them. Holly Electric, Inc. lists Generac PowerPro Premier dealer and KOHLER Titanium Tier dealer. Del Sol Electric, LLC lists Spanish spoken. Preston-Link Electric, Inc. lists founder Jay Linkenhelt, continued by family, bonded, licensed, and insured, and a drug-free workplace. Confirm the license number and expiration on the linked DBPR page.

## FAQ

### Are these Florida electrical licenses listed as active?

Yes. Each is a Certified Electrical Contractor license with Florida DBPR status Current, Active. The expiration date on the record is 08/31/2026 or 08/31/2028.

### Which listings show a Gainesville location?

Del Sol Electric, LLC, Preston-Link Electric, Inc., and All Florida Electric Company, Inc. are in Gainesville. Callahan Electric LLC is listed as Gainesville / Alachua. Blackwell Electric LLC is in Newberry, and Holly Electric, Inc. is in Lake City; both are listed as serving Gainesville.

### Who lists 24-hour response or free estimates?

Blackwell Electric LLC, Holly Electric, Inc., Del Sol Electric, LLC, and Preston-Link Electric, Inc. list on-call or 24-hour service. Free estimates are listed for Blackwell Electric LLC and Del Sol Electric, LLC, and free estimates on most jobs for Holly Electric, Inc.
